front: Elle s'habille toujours avec beaucoup d'élégance.
pronunciation: [el sah-beey too-zhoor ah-vek boh-koo day-lay-GAHNS]
back: She always dresses very elegantly.
context: 'S'habiller' = to get dressed / to dress (in a style).

front: Il a un style très décontracté.
pronunciation: [ee lah an steel treh day-kohn-trak-TAY]
back: He has a very casual style.

front: Je porte un costume pour l'entretien.
pronunciation: [zhuh port an kos-TÜM poor lahn-truh-TYAN]
back: I'm wearing a suit for the interview.
context: False friend: 'un costume' = a suit (a costume is 'un déguisement').

front: Cette robe te va à merveille.
pronunciation: [set rob tuh vah ah mehr-VAY]
back: That dress looks wonderful on you.

front: Ce pantalon est trop moulant.
pronunciation: [suh pahn-tah-lohn eh troh moo-LAHN]
back: These trousers are too tight.

front: La veste est un peu trop large aux épaules.
pronunciation: [lah vest eh tan puh troh LARZH oh zay-POHL]
back: The jacket is a bit too wide at the shoulders.

front: Cette chemise en lin est parfaite pour l'été.
pronunciation: [set shuh-meez ahn LAN eh par-feh poor lay-TAY]
back: This linen shirt is perfect for summer.
context: Fabrics: le coton, le lin (linen), la laine (wool), la soie (silk), le cuir (leather).

front: Un pull en laine, c'est indispensable en hiver.
pronunciation: [an pül ahn LEN, seh tan-dees-pahn-SAH-bluh ahn nee-VEHR]
back: A wool sweater is essential in winter.
context: 'En' + material: en laine, en coton, en cuir.

front: Il porte une chemise à rayures avec un pantalon uni.
pronunciation: [eel port ün shuh-meez ah rah-YÜR ah-vek an pahn-tah-lohn ü-NEE]
back: He's wearing a striped shirt with plain trousers.
context: Patterns: à rayures (striped), à carreaux (checked), à fleurs (floral), à pois (polka dot), uni (plain).

front: Le noir, ça va avec tout.
pronunciation: [luh NWAHR, sah vah ah-vek TOO]
back: Black goes with everything.

front: Ces chaussures ne vont pas avec ta robe.
pronunciation: [say shoh-sür nuh vohn pah ah-vek tah ROB]
back: These shoes don't go with your dress.
context: 'Ne pas aller avec' = not to match.

front: Elle est toujours à la mode.
pronunciation: [el eh too-zhoor ah lah MOD]
back: She's always fashionable.
context: 'À la mode' = in fashion; 'démodé' = out of fashion.

front: C'est complètement démodé !
pronunciation: [seh kohm-plet-mahn day-moh-DAY]
back: That's completely out of fashion!

front: Le style parisien, c'est simple, chic et un peu négligé.
pronunciation: [luh steel pah-ree-ZYAN, seh SAN-pluh, SHEEK ay an puh nay-glee-ZHAY]
back: Parisian style is simple, chic and a little effortless.
context: 'Négligé' here = deliberately casual. 'Le chic à la française'.

front: J'aime m'habiller en friperie.
pronunciation: [zhem mah-bee-yay ahn free-puh-REE]
back: I like buying clothes at thrift stores.
context: 'Une friperie' = second-hand clothing shop. 'La seconde main' = second-hand.

front: Je fais attention à acheter des vêtements éthiques.
pronunciation: [zhuh feh zah-tahn-SYOHN ah ahsh-tay day vet-mahn ay-TEEK]
back: I'm careful to buy ethical clothing.
context: 'La mode éthique / durable' = ethical / sustainable fashion.

front: La fast fashion pollue énormément.
pronunciation: [lah fast FASH-un poh-LÜ ay-nor-may-MAHN]
back: Fast fashion pollutes enormously.

front: Il a mis un jean et des baskets blanches.
pronunciation: [ee lah mee an DJEEN ay day bas-ket BLAHNSH]
back: He put on jeans and white sneakers.

front: Enlève tes chaussures en entrant.
pronunciation: [ahn-lev tay shoh-SÜR ahn nahn-TRAHN]
back: Take your shoes off when you come in.
context: 'Enlever' = to take off; 'en entrant' = when coming in.

front: Elle s'est changée avant de sortir.
pronunciation: [el seh shahn-ZHAY ah-vahn duh sor-TEER]
back: She got changed before going out.

front: Ce manteau est trop chaud pour la saison.
pronunciation: [suh mahn-toh eh troh SHOH poor lah seh-ZOHN]
back: This coat is too warm for the season.

front: Il faut repasser cette chemise, elle est toute froissée.
pronunciation: [eel foh ruh-pah-say set shuh-MEEZ, el eh toot frwah-SAY]
back: This shirt needs ironing, it's all creased.

front: Ce pull a rétréci au lavage.
pronunciation: [suh pül ah ray-tray-SEE oh lah-VAHZH]
back: This sweater shrank in the wash.

front: Elle porte des boucles d'oreilles en or.
pronunciation: [el port day boo-kluh doh-RAY ahn NOR]
back: She's wearing gold earrings.
context: Accessories: un collier (necklace), une bague (ring), un bracelet.

front: Il ne sort jamais sans sa casquette.
pronunciation: [eel nuh sor zhah-meh sahn sah kas-KET]
back: He never goes out without his cap.

front: Pour la soirée, la tenue est correcte exigée.
pronunciation: [poor lah swah-RAY, lah tuh-nü eh koh-rekt eg-zee-ZHAY]
back: For the event, smart dress is required.

front: Il était habillé n'importe comment.
pronunciation: [ee lay-teh tah-bee-yay nan-port koh-MAHN]
back: He was dressed any old how.

front: Je me sens mieux dans des vêtements amples.
pronunciation: [zhuh muh sahn MYUH dahn day vet-mahn ZAHM-pluh]
back: I feel better in loose clothes.

front: La Fashion Week de Paris attire le monde entier.
pronunciation: [lah fash-un WEEK duh pah-REE ah-teer luh mohnd ahn-TYAY]
back: Paris Fashion Week attracts the whole world.
context: 'La haute couture' is a protected label in France.

front: Coco Chanel a révolutionné la mode féminine.
pronunciation: [koh-koh shah-NEL ah ray-voh-lü-syoh-nay lah mod fay-mee-NEEN]
back: Coco Chanel revolutionized women's fashion.
context: Known for the little black dress ('la petite robe noire').

front: Tu trouves que ça me va ?
pronunciation: [tü troov kuh sah muh VAH]
back: Do you think it suits me?

front: Franchement, ce n'est pas trop ton style.
pronunciation: [frahnsh-MAHN, suh neh pah troh tohn STEEL]
back: Honestly, it's not really your style.

front: Je n'ai rien à me mettre !
pronunciation: [zhuh neh ryan nah muh MEH-truh]
back: I have nothing to wear!
context: The universal complaint before going out.

front: Elle a le sens du détail.
pronunciation: [el ah luh sahns dü day-TAHY]
back: She has an eye for detail.
context: 'Avoir le sens de' = to have a sense of.

front: Ce qui compte, c'est de se sentir bien dans ses vêtements.
pronunciation: [suh kee KOHNT, seh duh suh sahn-teer BYAN dahn say vet-MAHN]
back: What matters is feeling good in your clothes.
